text: {"lessons":["I held through a substantial decline without reviewing my exposure; I should check risk and allocation periodically instead of letting loss aversion keep me inactive.","Selling Stock B and Stock C at gains felt rewarding, but gains alone should not trigger a sale; I should follow a consistent plan based on portfolio goals and risk.","After selling Stock C, I spread the proceeds across several stocks; I should keep diversification in mind, while remembering that past price changes do not predict future returns."]}
